body: Query form ?ticket=<id> plus optional #comment=<id> (works with pman serve's single route). Verified in Chromium: click pushes one history entry per explicit ticket change, back/forward restore the ticket and the tab's list filter, reload and direct links open the ticket without implicit filters, comment links focus the comment; unknown ticket shows 'Ticket not found', missing comment shows a notice. Server error messages no longer expose absolute local paths.
author: claude
